messages:
Jordan P: Hi payroll — I submitted a W-4 change on 09/02 to switch from Single to Married filing status and updated allowances, but my 9/15 paycheck still shows the old federal withholding. Did my update get applied?
Jade (Payroll): Sorry about that — can you DM the EmpID so I can pull your profile? Also when exactly did you submit via self-service?
Jordan P: EmpID 007254. I updated on 2024-09-02 at ~10:30am and confirmed the change on the confirmation page.
payroll-bot: W-4 change received 2024-09-02 for EmpID 007254. Confirmation email sent.
Jade (Payroll): Looking now... your HR record shows the W-4 change timestamped 09/02, but payroll profile for the 09/15 run still had the prior federal code. Seems like the W-4 import feed didn't pick up the delta before the payroll cutoff.
Maria HR: Is this a one-off timing issue or systemic? If it hit cutoff windows we might need a process note to alert employees about effective dates.
Jade (Payroll): Preliminary: import job that syncs W-4s runs at 10pm UTC daily; your change was after the 10pm cut for the 9/15 run (local times caused confusion). We'll add a UX banner but for you we can process an off-cycle federal withholding adjustment (retro) to correct YTD federal withholding and tax. That will minimize year-end surprises.
Jordan P: Will this affect how I file 2024? Do I need to do anything for estimated payments or the IRS?
Jade (Payroll): We will correct your YTD federal withholding by moving the withholding amounts to match the new W-4 for pay periods after 09/02. If that reduces your federal withholding YTD we'll document it but you don't need to contact the IRS. If you prefer, you can request us to leave it as-is and change future withholding only — but retro is generally better for accuracy. If any withholding changes require W-2c at year end we'll handle that.
TaxOps Bot: Reminder: Retro federal withholding adjustments may change employee/ employer tax totals. Notify TaxOps for reconciliation.
Jade (Payroll): Next steps: (1) DM us signature for retro authorization (we'll send form). (2) We'll queue the off-cycle adjustment to run this week. (3) We'll validate with TaxOps and update runbook to clarify W-4 effective date language and cutoff times.
Jordan P: Happy to sign. Please also add the UX banner — thought I beat the cutoff but timezone confused me. Thanks for the quick response.
Jade (Payroll): Sending the DM now. Will update thread when the correction posts. :thumbsup:
